plans.note: Section 21 sets a mutual cap at greater of 12 months' Fees or USD 1,000,000 with Excluded Claims defined in 21.3; check cap adequacy (data/security incidents) and that direct-damages language in 21.2 and unlimited carve-outs are preserved.

Vendor IP indemnity (20.1) and conduct indemnity (20.2) are present; confirm Customer's reverse indemnity in 20.3 stays narrow, procedure in 20.4 is balanced, and 20.5 mitigation/refund plus uncapped treatment via 21.3 hold.
Section 12.3 expressly disclaims non-compete, MFN, minimum-volume and no-hire commitments; scan for any inconsistent restriction (e.g., sec-2.2 exclusivity, sec-12.4 no-hire) that undercuts it.
Sec-2.2 (first of two 2.2s) makes Vendor sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics — flag for deletion; sec-2.1 and 12.3 support our no-commitment position.
Sec-7.2 (first of two 7.2s) requires Customer to give Vendor best terms offered any other supplier — wrong direction; delete and rely on 12.3's MFN disclaimer.

Sec-12.4 binds only Customer for 18 months covering all Vendor employees with no general-advertising carve-out; narrow to 12 months, personnel actually engaged, mutual, with advertising/unsolicited carve-out.

Section 9 contains only for-cause, insolvency and security/SLA termination rights; no Customer termination for convenience — add a Customer-only convenience right with pro-rata refund (see 10.2 for refund mechanics).
Sec-8.2 requires 180 days' non-renewal notice — reduce to 30–60 days; 8.3 uplift cap (lesser of CPI and 3%) with 90 days' notice is acceptable.
New York law and New York County courts with no foreign arbitration — compliant; confirm CISG waiver and escalation in 28.3 do not delay urgent relief.

24.1 permits Customer affiliate/successor assignment, 24.2 restricts Vendor, 24.4 blocks Vendor termination or repricing on our change of control; verify 24.3 catch-all does not swallow 24.1 and that 13.3 licence transfer aligns.

Customer ownership of Data (14.1) and Deliverables (14.2) is present; check the payment condition in 14.2, the Deliverable/Vendor Technology definitions (1.4, 1.8), and telemetry carve-out in 1.3 plus no-model-training limit in 15.1.

13.1 covers Affiliates and contractors and 13.2 grants a perpetual paid-up licence; confirm 13.3 suspension right is limited to material uncured breach after cure and that 13.4 restrictions are not overbroad.

Sec-22.1 allows unannounced audits and remote system access — replace with once-annually, 30 days' notice, business hours, off-site records review at Vendor's cost; 22.2 and 22.3 already carry cost-shift threshold and confidentiality protections.
Sec-7.6 imposes USD 25,000/day liquidated damages on Customer for dependency delays — delete; at most Vendor gets excused-performance relief for our delays.

Services and conformity warranties in 19.1–19.3 with re-perform/refund remedy in 19.4 and non-exclusivity language; confirm the 90-day Deliverable warranty period is long enough and 19.5 disclaimer does not erode express warranties.
Section 18 requires CGL, workers' comp, E&O and USD 5M cyber cover with certificates and no limitation of liability; verify limits against data sensitivity and cancellation-notice wording.
Sec-2.1 expressly disclaims minimum quantity or purchase commitment and 12.3 confirms no minimum-volume undertaking; confirm no Order Form-level take-or-pay or minimum-use charge sneaks in via 7.1.

Section 11 provides six months' transition assistance, 30-day data return in machine-readable form with no fee-dispute hostage, and certified deletion; check interaction with 10.1 access cut-off and 16.5 return/destroy obligations.
